name: HD 150193

paper.title: Near-Infrared Imaging of the Circumstellar Disk around Herbig Ae Star HD 150193A

images.note: J-band Q_r image (contour-free appendix version): weak tentative scattered-light detection around HD 150193A; SW blob is the companion HD 150193B. Obs 2014 Apr 23+24. New facility+band vs held Subaru CIAO H 2003 record.

paper.title: Polarized Disk Emission from Herbig Ae/Be Stars Observed Using Gemini Planet Imager: HD 144432, HD 150193, HD 163296, and HD 169142

notes: Herbig Ae star (~6 Myr) with a T Tauri companion 1.1 arcsec away; the held Subaru/CIAO H-band PSF-subtracted coronagraphic image revealed the circumprimary disk extending from 50 au out to about 190 au, with no circumstellar structure around the companion (Fukagawa et al. 2003).
